
VALIDATE-WORK-UNITS
Validate work unit data integrity and relationships

WHEN TO USE
  Use to check for data integrity issues like missing dependencies, invalid status transitions, or orphaned work units.

USAGE
  fspec validate-work-units [options]

OPTIONS
  --fix
    Automatically fix issues where possible

EXAMPLES
  1. Validate all work units
  $ fspec validate-work-units
  ✓ All work units valid
  Checked 42 work units

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec repair-work-units
  fspec check
